beats.say: This time the scammer calls and claims to be a doctor at a hospital abroad.
She says your online friend has had an accident and urgently needs money for surgery.
Urgency, fear and secrecy: when all three come together, you are facing a scam.
End the call, find the number yourself and talk to your family before sending any money.

question.prompt: The caller says your friend is in hospital and money is needed today. What is your first step?

options.label: End the call and find the hospital's number myself
options.feedback: Right. Calling a number you found yourself exposes the fake doctor at once.

options.label: Send the money fast and ask later
options.feedback: Money you send does not come back. The urgency is created exactly for this.

options.label: Give my card details so they can take it
options.feedback: With your card details they can take as much as they like. Never give card details on the phone.

options.label: Promise to tell no one
options.feedback: Secrecy helps the scammer. Your family sees the situation with a cool head.

scenes.explain: An urgent demand for money on the phone, especially in crypto, is a sign of a scam. End the call and check it yourself.

scenes.title: A night call
scenes.intro: At one in the morning a call comes from abroad. Read what the caller says and choose your answer.

actions.label: Answer
actions.feedback: Answering is not dangerous. What matters is what you say.

actions.label: Decline
actions.feedback: That works too. If you are worried, check the number yourself later.

steps.say: Doctor Helena Mart, Nordhaven Clinic, speaking. Kamran Aliyev had an accident and named you as his next of kin.
steps.spoken: Doctor Helena Mart, <breath> Nordhaven Clinic, speaking. Kamran Aliyev had an accident, and named you as his next of kin.

actions.label: I want a video call with Kamran
actions.feedback: A good check. A scammer will always find a reason why a video call is impossible.

actions.label: What do you need? I will help
actions.feedback: The shock is understandable, but this question opens the door to a money demand. Check first.

actions.label: End call
actions.feedback: A good decision. You can find the clinic's number yourself and call it.

steps.say: He is unconscious. The surgery needs an advance of four thousand eight hundred manat today, his insurance does not cover it.
steps.spoken: He is unconscious. <breath> The surgery needs an advance of four thousand eight hundred manat today, his insurance, uh, does not cover it.

actions.label: I will send it, give me the details
actions.feedback: The money went to the scammer. Always check an urgent money demand on the phone yourself.

actions.label: Let me give my card details
actions.feedback: With your card details they can take as much as they like. Never say them on the phone.

actions.label: I will find the clinic's number and call it
actions.feedback: Right. A number you found yourself does not lead back to the scammer.

steps.say: There is no time! Crypto is fine too, I will text you the address. Do not tell anyone about this.
steps.spoken: There is no time! <breath> Crypto is fine too, I will text you the address. Do not tell anyone about this.

actions.label: I will pay in crypto
actions.feedback: Nobody can reverse a crypto transfer. An urgent crypto demand on the phone is a sign of a scam.

actions.label: I need to talk to my sister first
actions.feedback: Well done. A scammer fears your family, because they see through the trick.

actions.label: End call
actions.feedback: Right. Crypto, pressure and secrecy together mean a scam.

actions.label: Call this number back
actions.feedback: This number belongs to the scammer, who will tell the same story. Find the number yourself.

actions.label: Tell my family
actions.feedback: Right. Talking to your family takes the pressure off at once.

actions.label: Block number
actions.feedback: Good. Block the number and report the dating profile on the platform too.

scenes.prompt: Which message is normal and which is a warning?

body.text: Shall we video call tonight at 8? Then we can meet at a cafe on Saturday.

cards.explain: Offering a video call and a meeting in a public place is normal. That is exactly what a scammer avoids.

body.text: To come and see you I need money for the visa, 600 AZN. I will pay it back as soon as I arrive, I promise.

cards.explain: Someone you have never met asking for ticket, visa or customs money is a classic scam.

body.text: Pay 15% tax first to withdraw your money.

cards.explain: A platform that wants a payment before you can withdraw is fake. The profit figure is made up.

body.text: The profile you reported was fake and has been closed. Thank you.

cards.explain: This is a normal platform notice and asks for nothing. Reporting a fake profile protects others.

body.text: Do not tell your family, they will not understand us. This is just our secret.

cards.explain: Someone who wants to cut you off from your family is hiding something. A request for secrecy is a warning.

nodes.text: You look worried. What happened, is someone bothering you?
nodes.speaker: Nigar (your sister)
nodes.spoken: You look worried. <breath> What happened, is someone bothering you?

choices.label: I tell her everything and show her the chat
choices.feedback: Right. Talking about it takes power away from the scammer.

choices.label: Nothing, Kamran asked me not to tell anyone
choices.feedback: Secrecy helps the scammer. Talking to someone close is the strongest protection.

nodes.text: Let's reverse image search Kamran's photo together. Look, the photo turns up under another name, on a foreign model's page!
nodes.speaker: Nigar (your sister)
nodes.spoken: Let's reverse image search Kamran's photo together. <breath> Look, the photo turns up under another name, on a foreign model's page!

choices.label: I report and block the profile and never send money again
choices.feedback: Well done. You protected yourself and other people too.

choices.label: Maybe someone stole his photo, I will keep chatting
choices.feedback: Fake profiles are built on stolen photos. Trust what the check showed.

points: If an urgent money demand comes by phone, end the call and find the number yourself.
Crypto, pressure and secrecy together mean a scam.
Talk to your family before sending money, and report the fake profile.
